comment: The contracts the UI reads (REQ-UI-001; A258). Two entry points are generated to ui/src/contract_types: customer.ts (the four public contracts and errors.v3: all a customer-facing page may import) and operator.ts (the customer set plus the operator and auditor contracts, among them reconstruction.v3 and record-event.v3, which carry tenant_id, the full events and their hashes). Each root is generated as TypeScript types and parsers with every contract it refers to; a contract the UI does not read is not listed, so it does not reach the client bundle.
